color-fg.$description: Default text color on light surfaces. Paired with color-bg, meets WCAG AA (>15:1) for normal text.

color-surface.$description: Slightly recessed surface used for cards and chips, distinct from the page background.

color-primary.$description: Brand/interactive accent color for primary actions.

color-primary-fg.$description: Text/icon color placed on top of color-primary. Meets WCAG AA (~5.2:1) against it.

color-border.$description: Default hairline border color for cards, inputs, and chips.

color-muted-fg.$description: Secondary/muted text color, e.g. captions and helper text.

space-1.$description: Smallest spacing step, used for tight gaps like icon-to-label.

space-2.$description: Compact spacing step, used for internal padding of small controls.

space-3.$description: Standard spacing step, used for button/input padding.

space-4.$description: Roomy spacing step, used for card padding and layout gaps.

radius-sm.$description: Corner radius for small controls like chips and inputs.

radius-lg.$description: Corner radius for cards and other large containers.

font-size-sm.$description: Small text size, e.g. captions and chips.

font-size-md.$description: Body text size, the default for UI copy.

font-weight-bold.$description: Emphasis weight, used for buttons and headings.

line-height-base.$description: Unitless default line-height multiplier for body copy.

button-primary-foreground.$description: Text/icon color of the primary button.

button-primary-border.$description: Border color of the primary button.

button-secondary-foreground.$description: Text/icon color of the secondary button.

button-secondary-border.$description: Border color of the secondary button.

button-radius.$description: Corner radius shared by all button variants.

card-default-border.$description: Border color of the default card.

card-default-radius.$description: Corner radius of the default card.

card-default-padding.$description: Internal padding of the default card.

chip-default-foreground.$description: Text color of the default chip.

chip-default-border.$description: Border color of the default chip.

chip-default-radius.$description: Corner radius of the default chip.

input-default-foreground.$description: Text color of default form controls.

input-default-border.$description: Border color of default form controls.

input-default-radius.$description: Corner radius of default form controls.
